== atm3
model 5
mixer [Beeper] [TS AY 1] [TS AY 2] [COVOX] [NeoGS] [NeoGS MP3] [MoonSound FM (OPL3)] [MoonSound PCM (wave)]
turbosound 2 ay
gs NeoGS
covox quad
network.card 0 comport 1
port 001F 00FF/001F Kempston joystick
port 001F FFFF/001F Beta128 FDC status/command
port 0033 FFFF/0033 Registered peripheral device
port 003F FFFF/003F Beta128 FDC track
port 0057 00FF/0057 Z-Controller SD data
port 005F FFFF/005F Beta128 FDC sector
port 0077 00FF/0077 Z-Controller SD chip select (reads #00)
port 007F FFFF/007F Beta128 FDC data
port 00B3 FFFF/00B3 Registered peripheral device
port 00BB FFFF/00BB Registered peripheral device
port 00BD 00FF/00BD Evo register readback (A12..A8 index); #10BD/#11BD breakpoint, #13BD virtual-drive mask
port 00BE 00FF/00BE Evo NMI / virtual-drive exit (write only)
port 00BF 00FF/00BF Evo config (shadow, flash write, font write, NMI, breakpoint)
port 00F6 00FF/00F6 Keyboard / Border 8-15 (no beeper)
port 00FB 00FF/00FB Covox (mono #FB)
port 00FC 00FF/00FC Border 0-7 (+ #7FFD when A15=0)
port 00FE 00FF/00FE Keyboard / Beeper / Border 0-7 / MIC+EAR
port 00FF 00FF/00FF Beta128 system register
port 37F7 0DFF/05F7 4 MB RAM page register (A15:A14 = window)
port 3FF7 0DFF/0DF7 ATM window register (A15:A14 = window)
port 7FFD 80FE/00FC Memory paging (#FD/#FC, A15=0; 1 MB mode uses bits 7-5)
port BFF7 41FF/01F7 Gluk clock data (#BFF7; #BEF7 in shadow)
port BFFD C0FF/80FD AY data
port DFF7 21FF/01F7 Gluk clock address (#DFF7; #DEF7 in shadow)
port EFF7 11FF/01F7 #EFF7: 16c / 128K lock / RAM0 / turbo off / multicolor / clock enable
port FADF 01FF/00DF Kempston mouse buttons (+ wheel)
port FBDF 05FF/01DF Kempston mouse X axis
port FF77 00FF/0077 ATM system port (video mode, turbo, pager, CP/M, palette write)
port FFDF 05FF/05DF Kempston mouse Y axis
port FFFD C0FF/C0FD AY register select / read
fulldecode 00FF/00C4 slot 1
fulldecode 00FF/00C5 slot 1
fulldecode 00FF/00C6 slot 1
fulldecode 00FF/00C7 slot 1
fulldecode 00FF/007E slot 1
fulldecode 00FF/007F slot 1
fulldecode 00FF/00EF slot 1

== sprinter
model 19
mixer [Beeper] [AY] [NeoGS] [NeoGS MP3] [Covox-Blaster]
turbosound 1 ay
gs NeoGS
covox none
network.card 0 comport 0
port 0010 00FC/0010 Z84C15 CTC channels 0-3 (on-chip)
port 0018 00FC/0018 Z84C15 SIO A / B data and control: AT keyboard, serial mouse (on-chip)
port 001C 00FC/001C Z84C15 PIO A / B (on-chip)
port 001F 0087/0007 WD1793 #1F / #3F / #5F / #7F, Beta #FF (codes #10-#15)
port 0024 00A7/0024 CNF / SYS: port map, clean rules, turbo, system RAM (code #C6)
port 0033 FFFF/0033 Registered peripheral device
port 003C 00BF/003C OUT #3C / #7C: system ROM out of / into window 0 (fixed decode)
port 0050 00E0/0040 IDE task file (codes #20-#29)
port 005C 00FF/005C OUT #5C: ROM_RG while the system ROM is in (fixed decode)
port 007B 007F/007B IN #FB / #7B: fast RAM in window 0 on / off (fixed decode)
port 0082 00E7/0082 Window 0 page (code #E8)
port 0089 00E7/0081 PORT_Y / RGADR: graphics row (code #C4)
port 00A2 00E7/00A2 Window 1 page (code #E9)
port 00B3 FFFF/00B3 Registered peripheral device
port 00BB FFFF/00BB Registered peripheral device
port 00BD 00E7/00A5 #xxBD group: density #01BD / #21BD, CMOS #DFBD / #BFBD / #FFBD, ISA #9FBD, frame #40BD / #60BD (codes #16-#1E, #2C, #2D)
port 00C1 00E7/00C1 RGMOD: mode table page (code #C5)
port 00C2 00E7/00C2 Window 2 page (code #EA)
port 00E2 00E7/00E2 Window 3 page (code #F0)
port 00EE 00FE/00EE Z84C15 SCRP / SCDP: WCR, MWBR, CSBR, MCR (on-chip)
port 00F0 00FE/00F0 Z84C15 watchdog WDTMR / WDTCR (on-chip)
port 00F4 00FF/00F4 Z84C15 interrupt priority (on-chip)
port 00FE 0001/0000 Keyboard / Beeper / Border / MIC+EAR
port 00FF FFFF/00FF Registered peripheral device
port 1FFD E0E7/00E5 #1FFD Scorpion paging (code #C0)
port 204E E0E7/2046 ALL_MODE (code #C3)
port 7FFD C0E7/40E5 #7FFD Spectrum paging (code #C1)
port BFFD C002/8000 AY / TurboSound data
port FADF 023F/021F Kempston mouse buttons (+ wheel)
port FBDF 023F/021F Kempston mouse X axis
port FFDF 023F/021F Kempston mouse Y axis
port FFFD C002/C000 AY / TurboSound register select (chip select)
